speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain and cramping. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Pain with urination, Burning pain during intercourse. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID). The patient's symptoms of lower abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, dysuria, and post-coital pain in a sexually active teenager, combined with her recent inconsistent condom use, strongly suggest PID. The previous suggestion of iron deficiency anemia is inconsistent with her acute inflammatory presentation.
